name: Restrictive Declaration Sites
description: This dataset lists 28 restrictive declaration sites in New York City, mostly privately owned waterfront parcels set aside as public access areas under restrictive declarations. Each record identifies the site by property name, GIS property number, location description, borough, community board, council district, police precinct, ZIP code, and state and federal legislative districts. It also includes acreage, waterfront status, jurisdiction (all listed as private), and the developer associated with the site. A flag indicates whether the site is rated in the city's park inspection program, and a comments field notes rating status or boundary issues. Several columns, including commission and acquisition fields, are entirely empty, and a few entries contain spelling variants of "restrictive declaration." The data could support planning and oversight work, such as mapping public-access waterfront sites, tracking which parcels are subject to restrictive declarations, identifying responsible developers, or analyzing the geographic and political distribution of these sites across boroughs and districts.
